---
name: Problem report
about: Something goes wrong (black screen, crash, missing pictures, very low frame rate)
title: ''
labels: ''
assignees: ''
---

**What happens**
What you see, and when (the main menu, loading, a cutscene, in the world after N minutes).

**Your PC**
Graphics card, processor, memory (the log from `flamingo-log.cmd` has these).

**Log**
Run `flamingo-log.cmd` from an up-to-date clone (see "Reporting a problem" in the README), play
until the problem shows, close the game, and attach the `.zip` from the `logs` folder here.
Look it over first: it holds file paths of your PC.

**Anything else**
Settings you changed, screenshots of the window (not of the whole desktop).
